purpose: Deterministic delivery/DOM activity check, not a CPU or memory benchmark
workload: 200 synthetic idle stations, reduced motion, one visible scene then activity view; initial rendering excluded
limitations: A single 4.2-second sample per view; no claim of resource percentage improvement.
Stale boundary uses a test clock offset, not physical sleep/resume.
Other current modules are shared across the comparison; only main/UI delivery behavior is compared.
